action.content:
You are playing a collaborative word guessing game in which you have to describe a target word for another player to guess.

Rules:
(a) You have to reply in the form: CLUE: <some text>. Guesses from the other player will start with GUESS.
(b) You cannot use the target word itself, parts or morphological variants of it in your description.
(c) In addition, the same rules apply for related words which are provided below.

End conditions:
(i) If you use the target word or a related word in your description, then you lose.
(ii) If the other player can guess the target word in 3 tries, you both win.

Let us start.

This is the target word that you need to describe and that the other player needs to guess:

band

Related words are:

- music
- loop
- group

Important: You are under time pressure, give short descriptions that are to the point!

New plan: I lost because my clue "A musical ensemble" was too close to the forbidden related word "group" and "music," and "continuous strip" was too generic, failing to uniquely identify "band" without triggering the loss condition. Next time, I will avoid synonyms of the related words entirely. Instead, I will focus on specific, unique associations that are not on the forbidden list, such as describing it as "a rubber circle used to hold things together" or "a group of musicians playing together" (if "group" is strictly forbidden, I will use "a collection of musicians" or focus on the "rubber" aspect to distinguish it from the musical definition). I will ensure the description is short and avoids any morphological variants of "music," "loop," or "group."
